mapper.sql: contractor_id, name, uscc, ctype, legal_person, legal_phone, safety_person, safety_phone, register_address, register_capital, deposit, login_account, approve_status, reject_reason, creator, open_status
mapper.select: select contractor_id, name from cbs.t_contractor where open_status = true and approve_status = 1 order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_contractor (contractor_id, name, uscc, ctype, legal_person, legal_phone, safety_person, safety_phone, register_address, register_capital, deposit, login_account, approve_status, creator, open_status) values (#{c.contractor_id}, #{c.name}, #{c.uscc}, #{c.ctype}, #{c.legal_person}, #{c.legal_phone}, #{c.safety_person}, #{c.safety_phone}, #{c.register_address}, #{c.register_capital}, #{c.deposit}, #{c.login_account}, #{c.approve_status}, #{c.creator}, #{c.open_status})
mapper.update: update cbs.t_contractor set open_status = false where contractor_id = #{id}
